long_biography.plain_text:
Rappuhn entered apartment development and construction in the early 1980s. Before establishing his own group, he served as executive vice president of Olympia Diversified Construction, supervising field development, construction-loan closings, draw advances and final inspections. That operating background gave him experience across the practical and financial stages of turning housing plans into completed communities.

In 1986, Rappuhn formed The Gateway Companies to develop, build and manage affordable multifamily properties. He combined development, construction, consulting, property management and asset management within one platform, using conventional lending, tax-exempt bonds, housing tax credits and public programmes. Gateway subsequently built a broad southeastern portfolio, while Rappuhn remained chief executive and sole stockholder. His work has centred on creating and sustaining rental housing for working families and older residents.
